input: Eizooba rikagwa ahansi y’eizooba, rikareeta omushana gw’obutagatsi omu nguuto z’omu rurembo ezirimu abantu baingi. Abantu bakaba bairukira aha mbaju z’enguuto, ebigyere byabo birikuhurirwa aha ruguuto obwo ebiganiiro birikwejwanzya bikahinduka okuborooga. Omu maka g’okunywamu, akawoowo k’omukaru gw’omukaru gw’omukaru gw’omukaru gukaba nigujwanzya n’akawoowo k’ebintu ebikozirwe omu nkoko, gukareetera abahinguzi kuhuumuraho bakanywa. Abarikweshongora aha nguuto bakayongyeraho okuteera akaari n’okuteera akaari, omu kaanya kakye bakahindura orurembo orurimu amaraka n’erangi. Omwabazyo ku gwabaire niguhika, etaara z’omu rurembo zikaba nizijwara, zimurikira okuzina okugumire okw’amagara g’omu rurembo okwabaire kutarikuhuumura buzima.

Omu mwanya muhango gw’ebibungo ebirikwetoorora n’ebibira ebiine ebimera bingi, omuyaga gukaba guhwehura ebihama kurabira omu mababi. Ebinyamaishwa by’omu ishwa bikaba bihunga ahansi y’ekitanda, emivuyo yaabyo ekaba neekorwa omu ballet etarikugamba ahansi y’eriisho ry’eiguru eririkureeba. Omugyera gukaba guzengyerera mpora mpora omu mwanya ogwo, aha mutwe gwagwo hakaba hariho omushana gw’eizooba ogurimu ebicupuri kandi gukaba gukora ebishushani ebirikumurinkana ebyabaire nibishemeza amaisho. Ebinyonyi bikaba byeshongora ebyeshongoro ebyabaire nibishusha nk’ebirikushoboorora aha byafaayo by’ensi ey’obuhangwa, ebyeshongoro by’amagara ebyabaire nibihurirwa omu busingye. Omu mwanya ogu ogw’obusingye, obwire bukaba nibushusha nk’oburikugyenda mpora, kikareetera obwire bw’okuteekateeka n’obusingye kutunguuka.

Omunda y’eibiikiro rikuru ry’ebitabo, hakaba harimu ebitabo ebitarikuhwaho, biijwire ebitabo bya buri nshonga yoona ei orikuteekateeka. Omugaju gw’empapura ezikuzire n’ebitabo by’oruhu bikaijura omu mwanya, byayeta abacondoozi b’okumanya kuza omu nsi ezitarikubarwa. Abashomi bakaba bashutama omu myanya mirungi n’aha meeza mpango, amaisho gaabo garikureeba empapura obwo ebiteekateeko byabo birikuzengyerera omu biteekateeko, ebitebyo, n’ebi baashangire. Obumwe n’obumwe, okuhindura empapura kukaba kureetaho okuhurira okutarimu kugamba okw’okuta omutima aha kintu. Aharuguru, ensi ekagumizamu neehunga, kwonka omunda y’ebisingye ebi, ensi yoona ey’obwengye n’okuteekateeka ekaba neetunguuka omu kuhuumura okurikuhikaana.

Omu katare akaabaire karimu abantu baingi, abashuubuzi bakaba nibateera akaari barikuteera ebiconco byabo, barikurwanira ngu abantu babateho omutima ahagati y’amaraka g’okuteera akaari. Emidaara ekaba eijwiire ebijuma ebirikushemeza, ebirungo ebirikunuuka gye, n’ebijwaro by’erangi nyingi, buri kimwe kikaba nikigamba aha ntandikwa n’eby’emikono. Abaguzi bakaba bagaaniira aha mihendo kandi baagaaniirana ebitebyo, bakareetaho ekishushani ky’okukwatanisa kw’abantu. Akawoowo k’enyama eziyokize n’ebihimba ebirungi kakaba nikasheesheka omu mwanya, kareetera abarikuraba omu mwanya ogwo kwejumbamu. Omu kavuyo, hakaba harimu omuhimbo oguri ahansi — omuhimbo ogwabaire gugumizamu akatare kariho kandi karimu amaani, obujurizi bw’omwoyo gw’ekyanga ogutarikuhwaho.

Aha nyanja mpango, ebicu bikateera aha mutwe gw’emeeri, byayohereza amaizi g’omunyugunyu omu mwanya. Abavugi b’emeeri bakaba bagyendera n’ekigyendererwa, barikuhindura emeeri kandi barikugyendera omu mwanya muhango ogwa bururu, barikwebemberwa enyonyoozi zonka n’okumanya okumanyirwe. Enyonyoozi ekaba neetunguuka etaine bugarukiro, ekipande ky’erangi ezirikuhinduka kuruga omu kasheeshe kuhika omu mwabazyo, kirikworeka oburungi bw’ensi obutaine bugarukiro. Ebinyonyi ebirikwetwa Seagulls bikaba byehinguririize ahaiguru, okuteera kwabyo kukaba nikuhurirwa omu maizi, kiyongyera aha kuhurira kw’amakuru g’enyanja. N’obu enyanja eraabe yaabaire eri yonka, okukunda eby’okweshemeza n’okuzoora ebintu kukaba nikutunguuka omu mwanya ogutarikuhwaho.

Omu mutima gw’ekishaayi ky’omu rurembo ekyabaire kirimu abantu baingi, abaana bakaba nibasheka baaba nibazaana aha bicupuri n’aha bicupuri. Amaka gakaba gateerana aha bitambaara ebijanjaire omu itaka, barikugaaniira aha byafaayo kandi barikushemerererwa bari hamwe ahansi y’ekicuucu ky’emiti mihango. Abavugi b’emotoka z’emigugu n’abavugi b’ebigaari bakaba bagyendera omu mihanda erikwetoorora, okutambura kwabo kukaba kureetaho okuhuumura kw’obuhangwa omu magara g’omu ndembo. Embaata n’ebinyonyi ebiine amapapa bikaba bigyendera aha mutwe gw’ekidiba omu muringo murungi, kiyongyera aha busingye. Eizooba ku ryabaire nirirenga, paaka ekahinduka omwanya gw’obusingye ahu abatuuragye b’omu rurembo baabaire bahuumura kuruga omu mirimo yaabo ey’obutoosha.

Enshozi y’orushozi ekaba neetureetera kureeba gye ebihanga ebyabaire byehinguririize n’enshozi eziri hare. Abatembire enshozi bakaba beehinguririize omuriro mukye, barikugaaniira aha byafaayo by’orugyendo rwabo n’ebirooto by’okuza omu biro by’omumaisho. Empeho ekaba eri nungi kandi erikugaruramu amaani, erikwijuza amahaha oxygen eshemeire kandi erikugaruramu amaani. Ebicweka by’orubaare bikaba bikwatsire aha nkungu z’amabaare, birikujwara gye ahansi y’omushana gw’eizooba ogurikwaka gye, birikutaana n’ensi erimu omwirima n’ebimera ebikye ebiri ahansi. Ebicu ku byabaire nibihinguraho, ebicuucu bikaba bizaana omu mwanya gwona, birikworeka oburungi bw’omwanya ogu ogurimu ebibungo. Omuntu ku arikwemerera ahaiguru y’ensi, akaba ahurira aine akakwate kakuru n’obukuru bw’obuhangwa obutarikuhwaho.

Omu kicweka ky’omu rurembo ekirimu obusingye, amaka gakaba gakora emirimo yaago n’omuhimbo gw’obucureezi. Abaana bakaba nibazaana hopscotch aha mbaju z’enguuto, okusheka kwabo kukaba nikuhurirwa omu mwanya obwo abazaire barikureeba n’obwegyendesereza bari aha bishengye ebiri haihi. Emisiri ekaba erimu erangi nyingi — ebimuri bya rose, tulips, daisies — byona birikurwanira omushana gw’eizooba n’okutaho omutima. Omugaju gw’ebishaka ebibaire biherize kutemwa n’ebimuri ebirikumera bikareetaho embeera erikushemeza eyabaire neekwatanisa n’ebikuru omu ka. Omwabazyo gukareetaho okujwara gye kw’ebitaara by’omu nguuto n’okuhurira ngu hariho okugumizamu kw’obusingye okurikukira kutamanyirwa kwonka okurikukundwa munonga.

Ebisigarira bya ira bikaba bigamba ebyafaayo by’obuhangwa obubaireho ira, ebisiika byabyo eby’amabaare bikaba bihweireho kwonka bikagumaho. Emizaabibu n’ebishaka bikaba bigyendera omu nshozi, birikworeka oku obwire burikugyenda n’oku obuhangwa burikugaruka kutunga ebihangirwe by’abantu. Abacondoozi bakaba bazengyerera omu mihanda y’ebifunjo n’omu bishengye, barikuteekateeka aha magara agaabaire gari omu bishengye ebi. Okuhunama kukaba kuri kwingi, kukaba kuteganisibwa okuhurira kw’ebigyere n’okweta kw’ekinyonyi kuruga hare kwonka. Eizooba ku ryabaire nirirenga enyima y’amabaare, ebicuucu bikaguma nibirenga, byareeta omuyaga gw’amazima n’okuha ekitiinisa aha mwanya ogwo. Kikaba kiri ekiijutsyo ky’okubaho kw’ebyafaayo okutahwaho n’ebitebyo ebyabaire bitairwe omu buri ibaare.

Omu kishaayi ky'enyonyi ekirimu abantu baingi, abagyenyi bakaba baraba omu bwangu baine ekihika ky'okutegyereza n'okukunda munonga. Enziga z’emigugu zikaba niziteera ahansi aha itaka erishemeire obwo okugaaniira omu ndimi nyingi munonga kurikwijura omu mwanya. Ebishushani bya dijitali bikaba birikworeka obwire bw’okuruga n’okuhika, birikwebembera abavugi abatarikugumisiriza nari abaine okushemererwa kuza ahu barikuza. Ebikopo bya kaawa n’ebipapura by’okuzingiraho eby’okurya bikaba biri omu nshonda ezimwe, obuhame bw’okurya kyamushana omu bwangu n’okutebeekanisa omu dakiika y’aha muheru. Omu kavuyo akatebeekanisiibwe, hakaba hariho okwetegyereza okurikugabwa — akaire k‘obwire bukye ak‘okukwatanisa ahagati y‘abanyamahanga ababohirwe ekyetengo ky‘ahamuheru eky‘okucondooza, kugaruka, nari kusherura entandikwa nsya. Orugyendo rukaba ruri haihi kugumizamu butoosha.

Aha kirwa ekirikushemeza, amaizi g’omugyera gakaba nigateera aha nkungu z’omushenyi ezitarimu kabi koona, gakaba nigareetaho okuhuumura n’okuteekateeka. Emiti y’enzigye ekaba neetengeeta nk’obushema omu muyaga gw’omu nyanja, ebishushani byayo bikaba nibitaanira kimwe n’eiguru eririkwiragura. Abaabaire nibaza aha nyanja bakaba banywa omushana, boombeka enju z’omushenyi, kandi bateerana ebishaka by’omu nyanja, barikwejumba omu by’okweshemeza ebyanguhi ebyabaire birimu paradiso. Ahansi y’amaizi, ebishaka by’omu nyanja ebiine amaani bikaba birimu ebihangirwe by’omu nyanja eby’erangi nyingi, ebirikureebeka kurabira omu maizi agarikwera ebyabaire nibyoreka ensi esherekirwe ey’okutangaaza. Omwabazyo ku gwabaire niguhika haihi, eitaka rikaba niritukura n’erangi z’omucungwa n’eza pinka, ekirikworeka ngu eizooba erindi ryahwa omu mwanya ogu ogw’obusingye. Oburungi bw’ekizinga eki oburimu obusingye bukaba nibuha omwanya ogurikwera hare n’eiraka ry’abantu ba buriijo.

Omu kyombeko kya ofiisi eky’omurembe, abakozi bakakwatanisa omu bishengye by’oruteerane ebyabaire biine ebisiika by’endabirwamu n’omu myanya y’okukoreramu erimu abantu boona. Okuhurira kwa kompyuta n’okuteera kw’amasimu kukaba kureetaho oruyombo orutarikuhwaho, orurikuteebwaho okuteera ebipande n’okuteera empapura. Ebishengye by'okuhuumuramu bikaha obwire bw'okuhuumuraho, na bagyenzi baabo barikunywa kaawa n'okugaaniira kwa buriijo. Ebipande ebirikwera n‘ebipande bikaba nibyoreka ebipande, obwire bwa purojekiti, n‘ebiteekateeko ebiri omu nkora, byona birikukora kuhikiiriza ebigyendererwa bimwe. N’obu haraabe haabaireho bingi, hakaba hariho ekigyendererwa n’okukora ebintu bisya ebyabaire nibishoboorora okusherura okutunguuka n’obusinguzi okw’obunaku obu.

Ekitebe ky’egaari y’omwika ekyabaire kirimu abantu baingi kikaba nikikora nk’omuhanda gw’okutambura, ahu ebitebyo ebitarikubarwa byabaire biteerana. Abavugi bakaba barahuka kukwata egari y’omwika zaabo, bakwatsire enshaho n’ebipapura by’okuhandiikaho, buri kimwe kiine ahu kirikuza n’ebirooto byakyo. Abashuubuzi bakaguza eby’okurya by’okurya n’empapura z’amakuru aha rubaju rw’ebicweka by’okuguza tikiti barikuhurikiza amaraka n’ebirango. Entebe ekaba neetetema ahabw’okuteekateeka ngu emotoka zikaba niziteera akaari, nizimanyisa okuruga n’okuhika. Omu mwanya ogu ogw’akaire kakye, obwire bw’okukwatanisa n’okusiibura bukaba bujwanzya, burikugarukamu emihimbo y’amagara ga buriijo omu nsi etarikurekyera aho kugyendera.

Omunda y’ekibira, omushana gw’eizooba gukaba gushenyuka kurabira omu nkungu y’ebibabi, guteera ebishushani by’ebicupuri aha itaka eririkworoba eri ahansi. Ebihangirwe eby’emiringo yona bikaba bigyendera omu mwanya gwabyo bitarikugamba, buri kimwe kirikukora omurimo gwakyo omu mutimbagano gw’amagara ogugumire. Empeho ekaba erimu omugaju gw’ebishaka, emiti y’emizeituuni, n’itaka eririmu amaizi, ekirikureetaho okuhurira nk’oku haabaireho ira. Omugyera gw’obucureezi gukaba guhingura omu miti, okugaaniira kwagwo kukaba kuri nk’eiraka eririkuhuumuriza omu ihamba eririmu obusingye. Ekicweka eki ekirikwera ekitakakwatsirweho kikaguma kiri obujurizi bw’okugumisiriza kw’obuhangwa n’oburungi obutarikuhwaho obw’ebicweka ebitakakwatsirweho.

Ekiyungu ekyabaire kirimu abantu baingi kikaba kirimu abantu baingi munonga obwo abafumbi barikutebeekanisa eby’okurya bingi munonga. Amakuru g’okusheeshasheesha kuruga omu biyungu garikujwanzya n’akawoowo k’ebishaka, ebirungo, n’omugaati oguherize kuteekwa, bikareetaho omwanya ogurikushemeza. Ebirungo bikaba bisharamu, bishukwamu, kandi biteebwamu ebirungo omu muringo oguhikire, buri kimwe kikaba nikihwera okuhikaana kw’ebirungo. Abakozi bakaba batambura bataine nshonga ahagati y’ebitebe, barikukwatanisa kureeba ngu buri nshaho yaahika aha kuhikiirira. Abagyenyi bakaba bategyereza eby’okurya byabo, okutegyereza kurikwombeka nk’oku ebihangirwe by’okuteeka byabaire nibiija hamwe — buri kyokurya kikaba kiri omurimo gw’obuhangwa ogwatebeekanisiibwe kushemeza ebiteekateeko n’okuhazya omutima.

Omu kishengye ky’ebishushani, ebisiika bikaba bishemeziibwe ebishushani bitari bimwe na bimwe, ebibumbe, n’ebishushani. Abagyenyi bakaba bagyendera mpora mpora kuruga aha kicweka kimwe kuza aha kindi, buri omwe arikwemerera kushoboorora n’okusiima okworekwa kw’abanyabwengye. Omushana gukaba nigworeka ebishushani n’ebintu ebikye, kikareetera ebishushani kuba eby’amagara. Okugaaniira okutarimu kugamba aha bukoryo, enyehurira, n’amakuru kukayongyera aha bugabe bw’okumanya. Omwanya gukaba guri omwanya ogurikwera gw’okuhangahanga n’okuteekateeka, ahu amaani g’okushoboorora ebirikureebwa gaabaire nigahiga emiteekateekyere mirungi kandi gakahiga okuteekateeka.

Omu kasheeshe kare munonga aha kidiba, oruho rukaba ruruga aha maizi mpora mpora, rureetaho embeera y’omuyaga. Embaata zikaba zivuga n’obushema, zisigaho ebicu omu bwire bwazo, obwo ebinyonyi by’omukishaka birikuguruka ahaiguru y’ebishaka. Okuhuumura kw’omu kasheeshe kukaba kuhendagurika ahabw’okuhurira kw’ebinyonyi ebirikweshongora ebyabaire nibishemererwa eizooba eryo byonka. Emiti eyaabaire eyehinguririize ekaba neeyorekwa omu maizi agacureire, ekirikureetera abantu kuhurira baine obusingye emirundi ebiri. Obwire obu obw’obusingye bukaba burimu oburungi bw’obuhangwa obucureire ensi etakasisiimukire omu bwijwire, burikwijutsya emihimbo y’obusingye eri omu nkora y’obuhangwa.

Etara z’omu kishaayi ky’emizaano zikaba nizikyeera obu omukingo gwabaire nigwimuka, kikamanyisa ekitebe ekitebeekanisiibwe ahabw’omuzaano ogutarikwebwa. Abazaani bakataaha omu mirimo yaabo, barikujwanzya abazaani n’ekihika n’obwesigwa, barikureetera ekigano kuba eky’amagara. Abahurikiize bakaba bashekyereirwe, okusheka n’okuteera engaro bikaba nibireetaho obwire oburikuteganisa n’okuhindura eby’okureeberaho. Ebyeshongoro n’omushana bikayongyera aha nyehurira n’embeera, byahindura omwanya kuba omwanya gw’okuteekateekaho n’okutangaara. Ekikorwa ku kyahwaire, abantu bakateera engaro, barikujaguza obuhanguzi n’amaani ebyareeteire omuzaano kuba ogw’okwijuka ahari boona.

Omu bicweka by’omu rurembo ebyabaire birimu obusingye, amaju gakaba gayemereire omu mirongooti mirungi, buri emwe eine omusiri gwayo ogurimu ebimuri n’ebishaka. Engudo zikaba zirimu amaisho g’abantu abu barikumanya n’okunyiganyiga kw’omukago, okurikworeka okuhurira kw’abantu b’omu kyanga n’okutebeekana. Abaana bakaba bazaana omu bishengye obwo abakuru barikukora emirimo y’omu ka nari barikugaaniira aha bishengye. Okuhurira kw’obucureezi okw’amagara ga buriijo kukaba kureetaho okuhuumuriza, kuhamya obukuru bw’eka n’okukwatanisa. Omwabazyo ku gwabaire niguhika, omushana gw’ebitaara by’aha rubaju gukaba gwakiira ekiro, gutaaha omu busingye bw’amagara g’omu kicweka ky’orurembo.

Omuhanda gw’omushozi gukaba guzengyerera guza ahaiguru kurabira omu itaka eririmu ebifunjo, gurikuteganisa abavugi b’emotoka z’emigugu ahabw’ebifunjo ebigumire n’amabaare. Buri ntambwe ekaba neeyetengyesa okuteeraho n’okumariirira, kandi bakatunga ebihembo ahabw’okureeba ebintu ebirikushemeza aha ruteerane oru. Empeho y’omu nshozi erikwotsya ekaba neegaruramu amaani ebiteekateeko, kandi ebimuri by’omu ishwa n’ebimera ebigumire bikaba bikwata aha nshozi z’amabaare. Obumwe n’obumwe, okurira kw’ekihungu kuruga hare nari okureeba embuzi y’omu nshozi kukaba kwijutsya abavugi b’emotoka z’emigugu oburungi bw’omu ishwa obubeehinguririize. Okuhika aha mutwe gw’orushozi kikaba kiri obwire bw’obusinguzi, obuhame bw’okugumisiriza n’amaani g’obuhangwa agarikutiinisa.

Akatare k’omu rurembo rwa ira kakaba karimu emirimo mingi, abashuubuzi barikuteera akaari barikuteera ebintu byabo kandi abaguzi barikugura ebintu byabo. Emidaara ekaba eijwiire ebintu ebikozirwe n’emikono, ebirungo, n’ebijwaro, buri kimwe kikaba nikijwekyera ekicweka ky’obuhangwa bw’orurembo obugaiga. Akawoowo k’eby’okurya by’omutaano kakaijura omu mwanya, kareetera abahinguzi kureeba ebirungo bisya. Amakuru g’ebyeshongoro n’okuzina kuruga omu batambi abaabaire bari haihi gakaba nigayongyera aha mbeera y’okushemererwa. Ekicweka eki ekyabaire kirimu abantu baingi kikaba kiri ekirikukira aha mwanya gw’okushuuburiramu; kikaba kiri omuhanda gw’okuteerana ebyafaayo, emigyenzo, n’okukwatanisa kw’abantu.

Ahansi y’eiguru nyekiro, omuriro gw’omu nkambi gukaba niguteera ebicuucu ebirikuzina aha maisho g’abagyenyi abaruhire. Bakaba nibagabana ebitebyo n’okweshongora ebyeshongoro, bashemererwa ahabw’okushemererwa okwanguhi okw’obunywani. Omuriro ogwabaire niguteera gukaba guha obutagatsi aha mpeho erikwotsya, kandi enyonyoozi ezaabaire ziri ahaiguru zikaba ziha ekishushani ky’omu iguru eky’okutangaaza okutaine bugarukiro. Okweta kw’ekihunyira kuruga hare n’okuhurira kw’amababi kukaba kureetaho okuhuumuriza. Omu kaanya aka, twehinguririziibwe obuhangwa n’abanywani, obwire bukaba nibushusha nk’obwemereire, burikuhamya okushemeza okutarikuhwaho okw’okuza aheeru.

Orukiiko rw’eby’obwegyese rukareetaho abanyabwengye kuruga omunsi yoona kugaaniira aha biteekateeko n’okugaaniira aha bihangirwe ebisya. Abagambi abakuru bakaha emishomo erikugaruramu amaani, baareetaho emiringo mirungi y’okubuuza n’okukoragana. Ebicweka by‘okugaaniira bikahiga okugaaniira kw‘okukoragana, okutunguura ekibiina ky‘ebiteekateeko by‘okubuuza. Okugaaniira aha kumanya kukaba nikugarurwamu amaani n‘eby‘okureeberaho by‘okukoragana n‘emirimo y‘obuhangwa, bikagaigahaza okumanya okurengire aha by‘obwegyese. Orukiiko ku rwahwaire, abeetabiremu bakatwara omu maisho enteekateeka nsya n‘enkoragana ezirikubaasa kubaho, bakareetaho entunguuka omu mirimo yaabo.

Enjura y’amaani ekagwa aha rurembo, ekareetaho okuteera kw’omuhimbo aha madirisa n’aha mutwe gw’enju. Abarikugyendesa ebigyere bakaba bairuka ahansi y’emikingo, amatembezo gaabo gakaba nigairuka kwonka gatarikurahuka, nk’oku ebishushani birikujwa aha ruguuto orurimu amaizi. Omugaju gw’ensi erikwotsya n’enjura ensya gukaba gugaruramu amaani ebiteekateeko, gukareetaho akaire k’okugaruka busya ahagati y’amagara g’omu rurembo. Amatara g'omu nguuto nigareeta omushana gwa zaabu, gutaana n'eiguru eririkwotsya, okwongyera obutagatsi aha mwanya. Okuhuumura n’obusingye bikaza omu mwanya gw’okushoberwa okwabandize, obwo orurembo rwakwatiraine n’okunywegyera kw’enjura okurikuhuumuriza, kurikwijutsya buri omwe amaani g’obuhangwa ag’obucureezi.

Hekalu eya ira ekaba eyemereire nk’obujurizi bw’emikono y’abantu n’eby’omwoyo, ebisiika byayo eby’amabaare bikaba bihindwirwe omuyaga n’embeera y’obwire kumara ebyasha bingi. Ebishushani ebibazirwe n’ebishushani ebigumire bikaba bishemeza omu maisho gaayo, birikuhwehura ebitebyo by’okwehayo n’enfumu. Abagyenyi n’abagyenyi bakaba batunga okuhuumurizibwa n’okuhimbisibwa omu myanya yaayo erimu obusingye, ahu okuhunama n’okuha ekitiinisa byabaire nibiijura omu mwanya. Okubaho kwa hekalu kukaba nikukwatanisa eby’enyima n’eby’obunaku obu, kukaba nikukora nk’ekiijutsyo ekirikwera eky’obuhunguzi bw’obuhangwa n’okusherura amakuru okutarikuhwaho. Omushana gw’eizooba ku gwabaire nigusheesheka omu nshozi n’omu nshozi, okuhurira ngu tihariho bwire kukaba kwehinguririza omwanya ogwo.

Karnavali eyabaire erimu obusingye ekaba eri ey’erangi, amaraka, n’okushemererwa. Eby’okuvuga bikahinduka kandi byaguruka, biijwire okuyomba kw’okushemererwa, obwo emidaara y’emizaano erikuha emigisha y’okutunga ebiconco n’okusheka. Abeshongozi omu bijwaro bakashemeza abantu baingi n'eby'emizaano, obukodyo bw'amahano, n'ebikorwa by'ebyeshongoro, byakwata ebiteekateeko by'emyaka yoona. Akawoowo ka cotton candy, popcorn, na sosegi eziyokize kakareetera abaabaire bariho kwejumbamu. Ekiro ku kyabaire nikihika, ebitaara ebirikwaka n’ebyeshongoro bikareetaho embeera y’amaani eyabaire neejaguza okushemererwa, okutuura omu bantu, n’ebintu byorobi eby’amagara.

Omu rusonda rw’ebitabo orurimu obusingye, emeeza emwe ekaba neemurikwa etabaaza, erikweta omushomi kwefeerwa omu kitabo. Empapura zikaba zirimu ensi z’okushemererwa, okumanya, n’enyehurira, buri emwe ekaba eri orwigi rw’okwetegyereza okusya nari okutoroka. Okusirika okwabaire kurimu kukareetaho okuta omutima aha kintu n’okuteekateeka, omwanya ogurikwera kuruga omu kavuyo akari aheeru. Haihi, obudaara obutebeekanisiibwe kurugiirira aha mutwe n’omuhandiiki bukaha ekishushani ky’obugaiga bw’ebiteekateeko by’omuntu n’obuhanguzi. Ekicweka eki eky’okwenda kumanya kikaba eky’okureeberaho ky’amaani agatarikuhwaho ag’okushoma g’okuhiga, okwegyesa, n’okuhindura.

Omusiri gw’emizaabibu gukaba guri aha nshozi ezirikuzingazinga, emizaabibu yaagwo ekaba erimu emizaabibu ehiire eyeteekateekire kusharurwa. Abakozi bakaba bagyendera omu muringo gw’oburyo ahagati y’enyuguta, barikushara n’okusharaho, buri omwe arikureeberera eitaka n’obwegyendesereza n’obukugu. Eizooba rikateera erangi ya zaabu aha itaka ry’ebishaka, rikahamya ebishaka ebirikushemeza n’ebirikwiragura munonga. Empeho ekaba eijwiire omugaju murungi gw’ebijuma n’itaka, ebirikworeka ekikuru omu magara g’obuhingi. Obwire bw’okugyesha ku bwabaire buri haihi kuhika, abantu bakaba nibateekateeka munonga aha viinyo ezaabaire zitakakozirwe kuruga omu birungo ebi eby’omuhendo.

Etawuni eyaabaire erimu orubaare ekaba eri ey’okureeba gye omu bwire bw’obutiti, aha mutwe gw’enju hakaba hariho ebijwaro byeru kandi ebicu byabaire bihanikire aha mutwe gw’enju. Engudo zikaba zirimu obusingye, zirimu okugwa kw’orubaare okukye, kikareetaho okuhuumura kw’obusingye. Abaana bakaba boombeka abashaija b’orubaare kandi bakaba barwana n’omupiira gw’orubaare, okusheka kwabo kukaba nikuhurirwa omu mwanya ogurikwaka gye. Etara ezirikwotsya kuruga omu bishengye by’okutuuramu n’omu maduuka zikaba nizitaanisa gye n’ebintu ebirikwehinguririza ebirimu obufuki, zikaba zireetaho okushemererwa okurungi. Ekicweka kyona kikaba nikireebeka nk’ekirikwaka ahabw’amahano g’obwire obwo, kirikweta boona kwakiira obusingye bw’obwire bw’obutiti.

Omu rurembo orurimu abantu baingi aha mwaaro, emeeri z’emigugu n’ez’okuroba zikaba zigurukaguruka aha mwaaro, emiti yaazo ekaba neehika omu iguru. Abakozi b’aha mwaro bakaba bagyendera omu bwire bukye, barikutwara n’okushohoza ebintu ebyabaire nibitunguura eby’entaasya y’orurembo kandi bikarukwatanisa n’ensi yoona. Emidaara y’akatare eyabaire eri aha mwaro ekaba neeha eby’enyanja ebisya, eby’emikono, n’ebintu by’okwijuka abagyenyi n’abantu b’omu kicweka ekyo. Omugaju gw’amaizi g’omunyugunyu, eby’enyanja, na dizero zitabwire omu mwanya, zirikworeka obukuru bw’amagara g’omu nyanja. Emeeri ku zaabaire nizitandika kuruga omu nyanja nari zirikuhika, orurembo rukaba rutunguuka ahabw’okutambura, eby’obushuubuzi, n’okukururwa kw’enyanja okugumire.

Obukugu bw’okuteeka bukaba bwijuza omu bakery akawoowo karikwotsya kandi akarikweta abarikuraba omunda. Omugaati n’ebihimba ebibaire biherize kutekwa bikaba bitebeekanisiibwe omu muringo gw’obwengye omu bibokisi by’okworekyeramu, ebicweka byabyo eby’ezaabu n’ebicweka byabyo ebigumire bikaba bigyeza ebiteekateeko. Abafumbi b’emigaati bakaba nibahurira barikuteera enfufu n’okukora emigaati, obukugu bwabo bukaba nibureebeka omu buri kimwe. Abaguzi bakashemererwa ahabw’embeera nungi, barikunywa eby’okurya ebirimu kaawa nari chai, barikugaaniira aha by’okurya ebikozirwe omu nkoko. Omurimo ogu ogw’okuteeka tigurikugaburira abantu eby’okurya byonka kureka gukaba gukwatanisa n’abantu kurabira omu buhangwa, obuhanguzi, n’okushemererwa okwanguhi okw’eby’okurya birungi.

Omu bwire bw’omushomo ogwabaire gurimu abantu baingi, abakozi b’emikono bakakora n’amaani aha mirimo yaabo, buri kimwe kikaba nikyoreka obukugu n’okukunda munonga. Ebintu bikaba biri kuruga aha mbaaho n’ebyoma kuhika aha nshaho n’eibumba, n’abanyabwengye barikuhindura ebintu ebitari birungi kuba eby’obuhangwa ebirikukora. Amakuru g’emisego, enyundo, n’eby’okujwara gakaba nigajwanzya omu kugamba kw’ebihangirwe. Abagyenyi bakaba bakunda eby’emikono, kandi bakaba bakira kuhigwa kukora eby’emikono byabo. Omushomo ogu gukaba guri obujurizi bw’obwengye bw’abantu n’okushemeza okugumire kw’ebintu ebikozirwe omu ngaro kandi ebiine amakuru.

Omu bwire bw’okujaguza oku okw’amaani, ebinyonyi ebijwekirwe ebimuri n’ebitaara bikagyendera omu nguuto, birikujaguza eby’obuhangwa n’omwoyo gw’ekyanga. Abeshongozi omu bijwaro bakazina kandi bateera ebyeshongoro, bakwatanisa n'abareebi b'emyaka yoona. Emidaara y’eby’okurya ekaba neeha eby’okurya by’obuhangwa, barikugaaniira aha bishaju kuruga omu b’obusingye obuhingwire. Empeho ekaba erimu okushemererwa, okusheka, n’okushemererwa kw’abantu boona ahabw’okwejumbamu. Ekiro ku kyahikire, ebirikwitsa omuriro bikamurikira eiguru, birikworeka enshonga y’okuhendera kw’omukoro gw’amaani kandi ogutarikwijukwa ogwabaire gureeta abantu hamwe omu kushemererwa.

Ekyaro ekirimu obusingye kikaba kirimu emisiri n’ebibira, ahu obwire bwabaire nibushusha ngu nibukyendeera. Abahingi bakaba nibareeberera ebirimwa n’amatungo, emitwarize yaabo ekaba neekomooka aha buhangwa bw’ebyasha bingi. Ebyaro bikye bikaba biri ahagati y’ebishaka, birimu amaju g’ebishaka agaabaire nigashushana n’ag’omu kyaro. Amakuru g’obuhangwa ag’obucureezi — ebinyonyi birikweshongora, omuyaga niguteera omu mababi, okuhurira kw’ente eri hare — gakareetaho amakuru agarikuhuumuriza. Ekicweka eki eky’omutaano kikaba nikiha omwanya gw’okuhuumuraho kuruga omu nshonga z’amagara g’omu rurembo, kikaijutsya abagyenyi obusingye n’obwangu oburikushangwa omu kunywegyera kw’obuhangwa.

Omu irwariro ry’obunaku obu, abashaho bakakora munonga kureeberera abarwaire, okwehayo kwabo kukaba nikureebeka omu buri kimwe eki baabaire nibakora. Embeera etarimu nshonga ekaba eri omwanya gw’emirimo, abashaho n’abashaho barikukwatanisa obujanjabi n’okureeba obumanyiso bw’omugasho. Tekinologiya y‘omurembe ekahwera omu kukyebera n‘okugaruka omu magara, erimu okuteerana kw‘embabazi n‘okukora ebintu bisya. Abarwaire bakatunga okuhuumurizibwa omu bukugu n‘embabazi z‘abakozi, barikwesiga ekigyendererwa kyabo eky‘okugaruraho amagara n‘obugwagye. Omwanya ogu gukaba guri obujurizi bw’okugumisiriza kw’abantu n’okugumizamu nibasherura okukiza.

Eihamba rikaba ritaine bugarukiro, omwanya muhango gw’omushenyi n’ebibungo by’amabaare ahansi y’eizooba eririkwotsya munonga. Cacti n’ebimera ebigumire bikahamira aha magara omu mwanya ogu ogugumire, okugumisiriza kwabyo kukaba nikureetaho okutiina. Abagyenyi bakaba bagyendera omu mwanya ogwo n’obwegyendesereza, barikumanya akabi n’oburungi oburi omu ihamba eri. Ebishushani by’omu mwanya bikaba nibitangaaza hare, ebishushani by’ebishuba ebyabaire nibizaana aha maisho kwonka bikayongyera aha nshonga z’amazima z’eitaka. Okugwa kw’eizooba kukahindura eihamba kuba ekipande ky’erangi erikutukura nk’omuriro n’emicungwa, ekishushani ky’obwire bukye eky’amaani g’obuhangwa agatari ga buriijo n’oburungi bw’ekitiinisa.

Akaju karungi akaabaire kari ahagati y’emiti mihango kakaba karimu omwanya ogurikwera kuruga omu nsi ey’aheeru. Ebishengye by’omuriro bikateera, bireeta omushana gw’obutagatsi ogwabaire niguhwera omu kuhunda kw’omu kyanga. Abagyenyi bakaba bahuumura barikushoma ebitabo nari barikugaaniira aha byafaayo, barikushemerererwa obusingye bw’okuhuumura kwabo. Aheeru, orubaare rukaba rugwa mpora mpora, rukingire omwanya omu rangi erikwera, kandi omunda, obutagatsi n’okuhuumurizibwa bikaba nibitegyeka. Ekicweka eki eky’omukago kikaba kirimu okugaruka enyima omu kworoba n’okuhuumurizibwa okurikushangwa omu kunywegyera kw’obuhangwa, okutoroka okuhikire kw’okuhuumura n’okugaruka omu buto.

Omu kishaayi ky’emizaano ekyabaire kirimu abantu baingi omu rurembo, abazaani bakatebeekanisa enyima y’ekishaayi, obusaasi bwabo n’okushemererwa kwabo birikuhurirwa. Aba orchestra bakateera ebidongo byabo obwo okuteera engaro n’okugaaniira birikwijura omu kishengye. Omukingo ku gwabaire gurikwimuka, ekitebe kikaba kihinduka ensi y’emizaano, eby’okushemeza nari eby’obusaasi, kikashemeza abahurikiize kandi kikareetera abantu kugarukamu omu nyehurira. Obumwe bw’okukora — abazaani, abeeshongozi, abakozi b’aha siteegi — bukareetaho ekishushani ky’omutaano ekyabaireho omu kaanya ako kyonka. Ekishushani ky’aha muheru ku kyahwaire kandi okuteera engaro kwatandika, oburogo bw’emizaano bukaijutsya buri omwe amaani g’okutebya ebitebyo n’okworeka omuntu.

Ekibuga ky’ekigombe ky’abanyamurwa ekyabaire kirimu obusingye kikaba kiri omwanya gw’okuteekateekaho n’okuhuumuraho. Abamonki bakaba bagyendera omu bishengye by’abamonki batarikugamba, barikureeberera emisiri kandi barikwetebeekanisiza okushaba buri izooba. Omugaju gw’obubaane n’ebimuri ebirikumera bikaba byongyera aha mbeera y’eby’omwoyo, bikareetaho okuteekateeka n’obucureezi. Abagyenyi nari abatuuragye bakaba batunga okuhuumurizibwa omu kworoba n’okuhana kw’amagara g’abanyamurwa, ahu okuteekateeka n’okutuura n’abantu byabaire nibikwatagana. Omwanya ogu ogurikwera gukaba guhamibwe omu buhangwa obumazire ebyasha bingi, kandi gukaba niguha omwoyo omwanya ogurikwera omu kavuyo k’ensi ey’aheeru.

Omu mwanya ogu baabaire nibakoreramu abantu baingi, abakozi bakakwatanisa kwombeka ekizimbe kisya, buri omwe arikuhayo obukugu bwe. Okuhurira kw’ebyoma n’okuhurira kw’ebyoma bikaba nibyoreka ngu hariho okutunguuka, kandi ebiragiro by’okwerinda bikaba birinda buri omwe kuguma aine oburinzi. Ebintu bikahika omu mugyera ogutarimu kuhinduka — seminti, emiti y’ebyoma, amatafaari — buri kicweka kikaba kiri kikuru omu kuhikiiriza oburingaaniza bw’omurimo. Abakugu omu by’obuhumbi na ba inginiya bakaba nibareeberera omurimo ogwo, barikuhamya ngu enteekateeka yaahikiirizibwa omu bwesigwa. Ekicweka ekyo kikaba kiri obujurizi bw’okwenda kw’abantu n’okukoragana okwabaire nikwetengyesa kuhindura enteekateeka kuba amazima.

Ekibungo ky’enyanja ekyabaire kirimu amagara marungi kikaba kirimu ebintu bingi ebiri ahansi y’amaizi g’enyanja agarikwera. Amashomero g’eby’enyanja by’erangi zitari zimwe na zimwe gakaba nigahunga omu mataagi g’ebishaka, kandi enyanja z’omu nyanja ezirikushemeza zikaba nizigyendera aha mataagi g’omu nyanja. Ebihangirwe by’omu nyanja ebigumire bikaba nibishagika ebika bingi by’ebihangirwe, buri kimwe kikaba nikikora kihango omu kuguma n’oburinganiza. Abavugi b’emotoka z’emigugu n’abavubi bakaza omu paradiso egi ey’ahansi y’amaizi, barikutangaara ahabw’oburungi bwayo n’ebintu bitari bimwe na bimwe. Okurinda emyanya egi etari y’amaani kikaba kiri kikuru munonga omu kurinda obugaiga bw’ebintu by’omu nyanja kumara emyaka mingi.

Omu hekalu y’Ababuddha eyabaire erimu obusingye, abamonki bakaba bakora emigyenzo n’okuteekateeka, ekyareeteire abantu bagira obusingye n’okuta omutima aha by’omwoyo. Omugaju gw’obubaane gukaba nigusheesheka omu mwanya obwo ebyeshongoro birikuhurirwa mpora, birikwebembera abarikukora eby’okurya omunda. Ebishushani n’ebishushani bya baaruhanga bikaba bireetaho emyanya y’okushabiramu n’okuteekateekaho, bikareetaho okuhurira ngu baine akakwate n’okuha ekitiinisa. Abagyenyi abaabaire nibasherura obusingye n’okwetegyereza bakatunga okuhuumurizibwa omu busingye obutarikuhwaho obw’omu hekalu. Emyanya nk’egyo erikwera ekaba neekora nk’omwanya gw’okucondooza eby’omunda n’okuhinga embabazi.

Ekicweka ky’okuzaaniramu ekyabaire kirimu abantu baingi kikaba kirimu abantu baingi munonga obu abavugi b’emotoka z’emigugu n’abavugi b’emotoka z’emigugu baabaire nibagyendera omu nshozi ezirimu orubaare n’omu mihanda y’omu nshozi. Entebe z’okusimura zikaba zitwara abagyenyi aha nshozi, zikaba zireetera okureeba gye omwanya ogurimu orubaare. Bwanyima y’ekiro kimwe ky’okushemererwa, abagyenyi bakaba bateeranira omu bishengye by’okuraaramu ebirungi, barikugaaniira aha byafaayo kandi barikweyotsya barikukoresa omuriro ogurikucumita. Omugaju gwa chocolate erikwotsya n’eby’okurya by’omutima bikaijura omu mwanya, byareetaho okushemererwa okwakuratsireho. Ekishaayi eki eky’okuzaaniramu omu bwire bw’obutiti kikaba kiri eky’okujaguza adrenaline, obuhangwa, n’obunywani, kikareetaho ebiijusyo ebyabaire nibimara obwire buraingwa bwanyima y’orubaare kusheenya.

Omunda y’ekishengye ky’okukyebereramu ekigumire, abanyasayansi bakakora okucondooza n’obwegyendesereza, barikwesiga okuhikiirira n’obukugu. Ebikwato bikaba nibitangaaza ahansi y’ebitaara ebirikwaka gye baaba nibashwijuma eby’okureeberaho kandi bakahandiika ebihandiiko, barikusherura okumanya aha by’obuhangwa nari okutunguuka omu bya tekinologiya. Okukoragana n‘okwenda kumanya bikareetaho emirimo yaabo, obwire obwingi bikareetaho okutunguuka okurikubaasa kukwata aha bantu omu muringo murungi. Eby’obuhangwa bikaba birimu obuteeka oburikutegyekwa n’okucondooza okutaine bugarukiro, birimu omwoyo gw’omuntu ogw’okuzoora n’okukora ebintu bisya. Buri kimwe ekyarugiremu kikahwera omu kusherura okuhango okwetegyereza n’okutunguuka.

Eduuka y’ebitabo eyabaire eri aha ruguuto oruhango ekaba neeshemeza abakunzi b’ebitabo ahabw’okugira ngu neeyeta abantu omu maisho kandi n’ebitanda byayo bikaba birimu ebitabo bingi. Abashomi bakashwijuma ebitabo ebitebeekanisiibwe gye, baazoora abahandiiki basya n’ebitabo ebitarikuhwaho. Omugaju gw’empapura ezikuzire gukaba guzingira abagyenyi, gwongyera aha kushemererwa kw’okukwatwaho kw’okuzoora ebitebyo n’okumanya. Abakozi abaine omukago bakatuha obuhabuzi, baayongyera aha nshonga y’omuntu wenka. Ekicweka eki eky’ebitabo kikaba nikireetaho okugaaniira, okuteekateeka, n’okwega, kikareetaho omukago ahagati y’ebigambo n’abo abarikubikunda.

Omu musiri gw’ebimera ogwabaire gujanjaire munonga, ebimera ebirungi kuruga omu nsi yoona bikaba nibyorekwa omu bicweka ebitebeekanisiibwe gye. Emihanda ekaba neezengyerera omu bishaka ebiine amagara, ebidiba ebiine obusingye, n’ebishaka ebiine ebicuucu, ebyabaire nibyeta okucondooza n’okuhuumura. Abahingi b’emisiri bakaba bareeberera buri kimera na rukundo, barikuhamya ngu ebika by’ebimera ebitarikukira kureebwa byagumaho n’oburungi bw’eitaka. Abagyenyi bakatangaara ahabw’ebimera ebitari bimwe na bimwe, beega aha nkoragana eri ahagati y’ebintu ebiine amagara n’emiringo y’okuhinga. Omusiri gukaba guri omwanya ogurikwera ahabw’abamanyi n’abasya, ekishushani ky’okutangaaza kw’obuhangwa n’obwengye bw’abantu.

Ekishaayi ky’okushemererwamu ekirimu abantu baingi kikaba nikireeta okushemererwa n’okuhuumura ahabw’ebimotoka byakyo ebirikuvuga emotoka z’emigugu, emipira ya Ferris, n’emizaano. Etara ezirikwaka gye n’ebyeshongoro ebirikushemeza bikareetaho embeera y’amaani eyaabaire neereeta abantu baingi kuruga haihi n’aheeru. Abaana n’abantu abakuru bakatunga obwire bw’okushemererwa n’okushemererwa, bakakwata ebiijusyo ahagati y’okushemererwa n’ebintu ebitari bikuru. Ebitebe bya Concession bikaheereza buri kimwe kuruga aha cotton candy kuhika aha by’okurya ebiine obutunguru, bikareetaho okugumizamu n’okushemererwa. Omuzaano ogu ogw’eby’okweshemeza n’okusheka gukaba nigujaguza okworoba n’okushemererwa kw’okwehereera okutaine kwerarikirira, kwijutsya buri omwe okushemererwa okurikushangwa omu bintu ebi barikugaaniiraho.

Omu nju y’okuraaramu ey’omu kyaro erimu obusingye, abagyenyi bakaba bashemererwa n’okuhuumura omu busingye kuruga omu nshonga z’amagara ga buriijo. Ebintu by’omukyaro hamwe n’omushana ogurikwotsya bikareetaho embeera nungi, obwo eby’okurya by’omutima birikuha obusingye n’okutunga eby’okurya. Eitaka eryehinguririize rikaba ririmu emisiri erikuzingazinga n’ebibira ebitarimu kugamba, birungi munonga eby’okugyenderamu n’okuteekateekaho. Okwakiira kwa mukama w’enju y’abagyenyi kukaba kureetera abagyenyi kuhurira bari ab’omu ka ye kandi bahuumura. Ekicweka eki eky’okwehereera eky’okworoba n’obuhangwa kikaba nikiha okuhuumura okurikugaruramu amaani, kugaruka kugaita abagyenyi n’omuvuyo gw’amagara g’omu kyaro ogurikugyendera mpora kandi ogugyendereire.

Ekyombeko ky’eby’obuhangwa ekirikushemeza kandi eky’omurembe kikaba nikyoreka eby’obuhangwa, ebyafaayo, n’eby’obuhangwa. Abagyenyi bakagyendera omu byorekyerezi ebitebeekanisiibwe gye, barikwejumba omu bintu ebirikukwatanisa n‘ebipande ebirikumanyisa. Eby’obuhumbi byonka bikaba biri eby’obuhangwa, birimu enkora y’okukora ebintu bisya kuhikiiriza ebyorekirwe omunda. Entebekanisa z’obwegyese n’eby’omutaano bikareetera abantu kwenda kumanya n’okwega. Ekyombeko ky’ebintu bya ira kikaba nikikora nk’orutindo orurikugaita ebyabaireho enyima, eby’obunaku obu, n’eby’omumaisho, kikahiga abagyenyi kusiima obuhanguzi bw’abantu n’obwengye bwabo omu miringo yoona.

Aha mutwe gw’orushozi orutarimu nshonga, hakaba hariho akaju kakye k’okuramizamu akarikureeba aha itaka eryehinguririize, kandi omutwe gwako gukaba niguhika omu iguru. Abagyenyi n’abagyenyi bakaba baija kutunga okuhuumurizibwa, kushaba, nari kureeba ebishushani by’omutaano byonka. Ebisiika by’amabaare n’eby’omunda ebyanguhi bikaba nibyoreka obucureezi n’okuha ekitiinisa, bikareetaho obwire bw’okuteekateeka n’okukwatanisa. Embeera egyo ekaba eri ey’okwijutsya oku abantu barikuguma nibasherura okukura omu by’omwoyo n’okwetegyereza. Eizooba ku ryabaire nirirenga, ekanisa ekaba neereebeka nk’omushana gw’amatsiko n’obusingye omu buhangwa bwingi.
